WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.death_country,
        SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL
      AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country
), above_average AS (
    SELECT player_id, death_country, total
    FROM player_totals
    WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM player_totals)
)
SELECT
    SUM(total) AS sum_of_totals,
    AVG(total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM player_totals)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: Each player is grouped by player_id and death_country; the average threshold is the average of per-player totals among players with at least one appearance row where both game counts are present.
